items.t: Paved and roofed area went from 3.1% in 1985 to 4.7% in 2025 across 660 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work (area-weighted).
171 of 749 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work have water the state lists as impaired for aquatic life; 151 have a discharge permit holder in significant noncompliance.
0 of 749 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work have a volunteer bug site surveyed since 2021; 66 of 66 high-need ones have none.
